name: combat-pds-context
description: A space combat in Wellon (101) with a Nekro PDS in the system opens its thread with the system image and the SPACE CANNON offer.

steps.note: Guards the combat thread output around the skipped PDS calculation: image and SPACE CANNON offer must still appear. A new thread takes the precomputed image; a reused thread from an earlier run in this game builds it inside initializeCombatThread. Both paths must pass.
